hooks.command: T=$(TZ=Europe/Berlin date +%H:%M); jq -n --arg t "$T" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:("Current Europe/Berlin time is "+$t+". You MUST begin your reply with the exact prefix ["+$t+"].")}}'

if [ -z "${DISPLAY:-}" ] && [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ] && ! emacsclient -e t >/dev/null 2>&1; then mkdir -p -m 700 "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/xdg-runtime}"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/emacs"; nohup emacs --daemon >>"$HOME/.config/emacs/daemon.log" 2>&1 & disown; for i in $(seq 1 15); do emacsclient -e '(fboundp (quote anvil-enable))' 2>/dev/null | grep -q t && break; sleep 1; done; fi
